rounds.text: While recent profitability spikes present an attractive headline, a closer look at the historical data reveals chronic underperformance, with a 10-year median return on equity of just 5% [E26] and a 3-year low return on equity of 10.3% [E63]. Top-line expansion has also lagged structurally, evidenced by a poor 5-year compounded sales growth rate of 8.53% [E62] alongside a longer-term 10-year compounded sales growth of only 7% [E14]. Operational stability remains a persistent concern, as both yearly and quarterly operating margins are explicitly flagged as inconsistent [E32, E33], while the signal engine notes that earnings growth is actively decelerating [E69]. Furthermore, despite a massive 195.9% twelve-month price return [E52], the stock carries extreme historical fragility marked by an annualised volatility of 98.1% [E54] and a catastrophic worst peak-to-trough drawdown of -95.5% [E53]. Compounding these risks, institutional money flow registers as negative [E44] with a recent holding reduction [E70], and borrowings have begun creeping upward to Rs 12 Cr from zero [E39]. Conceded: the company boasts a robust trailing twelve-month profit growth of 116% [E21] and a high operating cash flow of Rs 151 Cr [E35].
